test_is_local_endpoint: test the is_local_endpoint function to detect local and container DNS addresses
test_local_stream_read_timeout: test that stream read timeout auto-bumps to 1800s for local LLM endpoints
test_user_override_respected: test that user-set HERMES_STREAM_READ_TIMEOUT overrides auto-detection for local endpoints

test_container_dns_names: test that container DNS names like host.docker.internal are detected as local endpoints
